root.label: German study links high-fat diet, DCA bacteria and colorectal tumor growth

events.label: German study links high-fat diet, DCA bacteria and colorectal tumor growth

slots.name: human sample size
slots.sentence: To see whether the process they had observed in mice also takes place in humans, the researchers analyzed stool samples from more than a thousand people, both with and without colorectal cancer.

slots.name: publication date
slots.sentence: Their results were published in the August 2026 issue of the journal Gut .
